about_the_game:
Welcome to RestoRuzz — the most chaotic restaurant under the sea!

Step into a fast-paced, laughter-packed cooking adventure where teamwork, time management, and quick thinking are the ultimate ingredients for success. Whether you’re playing solo or with friends, RestoRuzz serves up frantic food prep, unpredictable customers, and roguelike-style progression in one tasty challenge.

Work together (or go it alone!) to take orders, whip up dishes, and serve them before time runs out. Earn cash to upgrade your kitchen, unlock new recipes, and grow your restaurant into a booming, quirky empire.

Key Features:
  • Chaotic Co-op Cooking: Team up locally with up to 4 players and keep the kitchen from catching fire (literally).
  • Upgrade Your Restaurant: Invest in equipment, expand your kitchen, and unlock clever upgrades to stay ahead of the chaos.
  • Colorful 2D Art Style: Explore a vibrant underwater world full of quirky characters, fun animations, and lively kitchens.
  • Strategic Teamwork: Divide tasks, manage time, and adapt as the pressure rises with every order.
  • Built for Local Multiplayer: Perfect for families, friends, or party nights — with keyboard and controller support.


Whether you’re a solo chef or running a full kitchen squad, RestoRuzz will test your skills, your friendships, and your ability to cook under pressure.

Are you ready to build your restaurant empire?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Ryzen 3 1200 / Intel i5-4570
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD Graphics 600 / Intel HD Graphics 520
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Game may experience short stutters on very low-end devices, especially on first load or in hectic gameplay moments.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Ryzen 5 3600 / Intel i5-10400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 / AMD Radeon R7 250 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Recommended for smooth gameplay in multiplayer sessions and when playing on higher resolutions.

short_description: A fast-paced cooperative restaurant sim where 1–4 players cook, serve, and upgrade their chaotic kitchen while tackling unpredictable customers and roguelite challenges.
